Description: The Artificial Intelligence Centre for Value-Based Healthcare (AIC) was commissioned to build infrastructure and pipelines within the OneLondon SDE to engineer and standardise multi-modal data (structured, unstructured, imaging) into OMOP format at provider level, facilitate federated cross-site analytics and multi-modal machine learning, and accelerate project feasibility assessment and 'time to data'.
